# Agent ETL Builder 0.2.0b1 — First beta

Local-first ETL agent that turns a natural-language request into a validated, executable
pipeline — and never runs generated code.

## Highlights

- **Natural-language planning with a local model.** Ollama drafts transformation steps; source
  and destination operations are bound deterministically from explicit file extensions.
- **Registry-constrained output.** The model receives a JSON schema derived from the
  transformation registry, then the normal plan validator is the final gate. Invalid drafts are
  repaired with the validator error, up to the clarification budget.
- **Conversational clarification.** `POST /runs/{run_id}/messages` continues a run that is
  waiting for missing paths or columns.
- **Read-only assessment.** Source-only requests profile the file, report quality findings, and
  propose a conservative draft before anything is written.
- **Approval gate.** Writes, destructive transformations, and plans marked
  `approval_required: true` wait for explicit approval.
- **Monitoring.** Redacted execution JSONL at `logs/<run_id>.jsonl` and a per-step transform CSV
  at `artifacts/<run_id>/transform_log.csv`, with stderr fallback and transform-log preservation.
- **Beta kit.** `scripts/beta_smoke.py`, `examples/beta/`, golden plan-shape tests, and an
  optional live Ollama evaluation.

## Quick start

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/erwingforerocastro/Agent-ETL-Builder.git
cd Agent-ETL-Builder
uv sync

ollama pull llama3.1:8b
ollama serve

$env:AGENT_ETL_OLLAMA_MODEL = "llama3.1:8b"
uv run uvicorn --app-dir src main:app --reload
```

In another terminal, from the repository root:

```powershell
uv run python scripts/beta_smoke.py
```

See the [README](https://github.com/erwingforerocastro/Agent-ETL-Builder#readme) for the three
request flows, configuration, and troubleshooting.

## Verification

- 782 tests passed, 5 skipped.
- 90.24% coverage (80% required).
- `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `mypy`, `uv lock --check`, and `uv sync --check` clean.
- `uv build` produces the sdist and wheel.
- Optional live Ollama evaluation: 2 passed with `llama3.1:8b`.

## Known limitations

This is beta software. Run state, conversations, and approvals are process-local; restarting the
API loses active runs. Natural-language generation is synchronous and usually takes 15–45 seconds
with `llama3.1:8b`. The source schema is sampled from the first 50 rows, so column and dtype
errors are caught during execution. PostgreSQL is adapter-only, the sandbox is an in-process
guard, and there is no web UI, log rotation, rate limiting, or approval-timeout timer for
API-pending runs.

Full details: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/erwingforerocastro/Agent-ETL-Builder/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
